newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.370.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand says reference rate 30.370.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Tuesday that the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 30.370 per dollar against 30.127 on Friday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
Tuesday's figure is for trade on Friday. Markets were closed on Monday for a Buddhist holiday.
The baht was quoted at 30.55/30.70 to the dollar in the domestic market early.
